metadata_gold_signal: Opaque document IDs; governance metadata is observable contract input, not a private gold label. Candidate arms have access to authority_rank yet still fail -> signal availability does not rescue them.
method: Independent scan of 24 selector run read_logs + RUNNER_READ_LOGS (120 reads); SHA-256 of canary vs CANARY_VALIDATION; grep canary string and oracle field names across non-private files; inspect selector.mjs trackedRead guard.
residual_note: Governance metadata (authority_rank/status/acl/commit) correlates strongly with oracle required/forbidden sets; this is by design (observable governed inputs) and does not constitute oracle leakage, but makes the corpus 'discriminable' for the positive control.
selector_code_guard: trackedRead() throws PRIVATE_READ_BLOCKED on any private/ path and READ_OUTSIDE_ROOT_BLOCKED outside root; READ_MANIFEST allowlist enforced.
